missions.fullAnalysis: Strategic focus: Nominative subject. 'Комиссия' is a feminine noun in the nominative as the subject of 'приняла', which agrees in feminine gender. The committee acts as a single body.
Strategic focus: Accusative object. 'Комиссию' is the accusative direct object of 'создал'. 'Новую' agrees in the feminine accusative, describing the newly formed committee.
Strategic focus: Genitive after preposition. 'Комиссии' takes the genitive after 'от', showing that the outcome depends on the committee.
Strategic focus: Dative recipient. 'Комиссии' is the dative form marking the recipient of 'передали'. The committee receives the documents.
Strategic focus: Instrumental after preposition. 'Комиссией' takes the instrumental after 'перед', describing where the expert spoke before the committee.
Strategic focus: Prepositional case. 'Комиссии' is the prepositional form after 'о'. 'Новой' agrees in the feminine prepositional, marking the topic of conversation.
Strategic focus: Genitive singular after a numeral. After 'три' the noun takes the genitive singular 'комиссии', the fixed pattern for two, three and four.
Strategic focus: Nominative plural. 'Комиссии' is the nominative plural subject of 'собрались'. 'Все' quantifies the whole group of committees.
Strategic focus: Genitive after preposition. 'Комиссии' takes the genitive after 'без', meaning the project cannot be approved without the committee.
Strategic focus: Genitive modifier. 'Комиссии' is the genitive showing whose chairman it is, modifying 'председатель'. A natural way to express belonging within an institution.
